revocation_reason: Hardware UART reached app_main and eliminated the ESP-Hosted reboot loop, but eager TinyUSB MSC storage allocation still failed with ESP_ERR_NO_MEM and a later boot-modem display submit timeout triggered a fatal dark halt. This artifact must never be installed again.
operator_direction: Recover the bound Waveshare 4.3 from the revoked 0.4.15 ESP-Hosted SDIO reboot loop using the verified 0.4.16 controller-first image. Reuse the existing factory backup; write only the primary application and do not touch the microSD.

preserve the 768x480 BBS shell, boot audio, touch, dynamic SD games, and existing microSD contents
